title: The Dead Couple
premise_public: A couple is found dead in a room with a puddle of water and broken glass.
solution_summary: The couple refers to two goldish; the bowl fell, shattered, and they suffocated.

facts.text: The puddle is from a bowl of water (aquarium).
The broken glass is from the fishbowl.
Cause of death is suffocation after the bowl broke.
No human attack or foul play.

acceptable_solutions: It was a fish and the bowl broke
The victim was a goldfish whose bowl shattered
A fish died when its bowl fell and broke
hints: Consider what else can 'die' in a room besides a human.
Puddle and glass might be parts of one object.
